name: hud_ui_check_toggle_widget_hide_preview
description: HudUiCheckToggleWidget::HidePreview skips disabled or checked toggles, otherwise stops rollover playback and delegates to the base ZRD hide-preview behavior.
known_limits: tier S verification remains deferred to the HudUiCheckToggleWidget source-cluster pass.
